Method of Attack: Plays audio file during lock screen
Encrypts victim's computer files without changing file extensions
Configures Windows desktop background to ransom wallpaper
Uses ransom note with email contact for payment instructions
Lock screen provides decryption if correct password entered
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with MySQL and MSSQL services
Indicators of Compromise: Executable files: MicrosoftHost.exe, Calipso.exe, Pokemon.exe, Pokemongo.exe
